summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back program announced 5 August 2026. The company purchased 1,300,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of 15.2748 GBP/share and 580,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at an average of HK$161.5632/share on 14 August 2026, for cancellation. Since program commencement, HSBC has repurchased 8,550,400 shares for approximately US$176.4 million. BNP Paribas executes the purchases. This is a routine ongoing capital return disclosure under a previously announced buy-back; the structural detail of cancellation supports the Capital Returns classification.
